chunks: "My father عليه السلام used to stand at al-Mash'ar al-Haram where he would spend the night."

key_terms.أَبِي: my father, referring to Imam Muhammad al-Baqir عليه السلام
key_terms.اَلصَّادِقُ: Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq عليه السلام, the narrator of this report
key_terms.اَلْحَرَامِ: the sacred, describing al-Mash'ar as a sanctified ritual location
key_terms.بِالْمَشْعَرِ: at al-Mash'ar, the sacred site of Muzdalifah in the hajj rites
key_terms.يَبِيتُ: he would spend the night, referring to the overnight stay there
key_terms.يَقِفُ: he would stand, indicating the ritual standing at that place

ai.seo_question: Where did Imam al-Baqir عليه السلام stand during the night at al-Mash'ar al-Haram?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام reports the practice of his father عليه السلام at al-Mash'ar al-Haram. The hadith indicates a ritual act connected to the rites and locations of hajj, specifically the overnight stay and standing at Muzdalifah.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2983 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"My father (as) used to stand at Al-Mash'ar al-Haram where he would spend the night."
